coordinate_system: Absolute unmodified PNG pixels; origin top-left. Explicit per-frame regions override equal-grid slicing. Foot positions are manually estimated reference roots; not approved for runtime animation.
body_height_definition: Common approximate hair-crown to grounded-foot reference distance, excluding tall backpack equipment, in source pixels. All frames use this fixed scale.

quality_notes.identity: Same male industrial-fantasy artisan identity, cream/teal clothing and brass/cyan equipment maintained.
quality_notes.alpha: True RGBA alpha, 16 major connected character components found with alpha>24; original pixels preserved.
quality_notes.layout: ImageGen did not honor equal square cells or the minimum 8px transparent gutter. Use explicit regions; never divide into equal cells.
quality_notes.gait: Front frames 0/2 and 3/7 are near repeated poses. Most front frames keep the same forward foot. Most back frames repeat the same leg silhouette. A mechanically complete left/right 8-phase walk is not established.
quality_notes.equipment: Front frames change handheld device grip/hand, causing visible discontinuity.
quality_notes.revision: One targeted built-in image_gen correction was attempted, but introduced missing handheld devices and still failed gait alternation. The more complete original candidate is retained and disabled.
quality_notes.foot_anchors: Manual root estimates are included for review convenience. Runtime foot-lock and seamless loop validation have not passed.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent 2D game walking sprite atlas, CH03 crystal-energy artisan mage.
Input images: Image 1 CH03_actions_front_v2.png is the canonical FRONT identity / costume / rendering reference. Image 2 CH03_actions_back_v2.png is the canonical BACK equipment / silhouette / rendering reference. Use them as reference images, NOT as atlas layout. Generate a NEW walk atlas.
Primary request: One square 4 columns by 4 rows sheet with EXACTLY 16 complete sprites, equally sized SQUARE cells, read left to right then top to bottom. Top two rows = 8 consecutive frames of a complete looping front-three-quarter walking cycle facing screen-right, with face and chest visible. Bottom two rows = matching 8 consecutive frames of a complete looping rear-three-quarter walking cycle facing screen-right, back visible. Maintain the slightly elevated orthographic camera of the references.
Identity: exactly the same adult male artisan, short wavy black hair, mustache/stubble, cream work jacket with dark teal shoulder panels and cuffs, teal scarf, dark charcoal-brown heavy trousers, brown boots, gloves, copper/brass machinery, cyan crystal at belt. Preserve the same round brass backpack disk with three vertical white-and-copper energy canisters, black flexible hoses and same brass handheld staff/device with cyan crystal core. No costume redesign.
Animation: Steady purposeful walking IN PLACE, carrying the crystal device low in his right hand, no spellcasting. Eight genuinely distinct leg and foot poses for EACH direction: frame 1 left foot forward contact with right leg extended back; frame 2 left planted down/compression with bent knees; frame 3 right knee passing forward beside left support leg; frame 4 left heel lifts while right knee/foot advances; frame 5 right foot forward contact with left leg extended back; frame 6 right planted down/compression; frame 7 left knee passing forward beside right support leg; frame 8 right heel lifts while left knee/foot advances, looping smoothly to frame 1. Clearly alternate left/right feet, clear heel and toe articulation. Opposite shoulder/hip rotation, moderate natural arm swing constrained by held device, coat tails and hoses lag slightly. Keep vertical bob very small. Never duplicate a static standing pose. Do not mirror the character's handed equipment between frames.
Composition/framing: same scale, same camera, same character horizontal center in all 16 cells. Feet contact anchor centered at normalized (0.50,0.86) in each cell. Total character/equipment visible height approximately 72% of each square cell, top around 14%, enough clear padding on all sides. Complete head, backpack, canisters, hands, device and both feet INSIDE each cell. At least 8 transparent pixels between adjacent sprites. Stable body axis with no side-sliding; no camera drift; identical body proportions and equipment size.
Style: match references exactly: polished painted isometric fantasy game sprite, grounded industrial fantasy, crisp detailed silhouette, warm brass, cream cloth and deep teal, clean cyan crystal accents, readable at small size.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA empty background, clean alpha, no ground or scenery.
Avoid: text, numbers, labels, dividers, grid lines, borders, shadows, floor, backdrop, colored matte, checkerboard pixels, extra characters or extra sprite cells, spell trails, casting VFX, extra limbs, cut-off parts, crawling, attack poses. Only the exact 16 walk frames in a uniform 4x4 grid.

rejected_revision.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit target: Image 1 is the generated CH03 walk sprite sheet. Images 2 and 3 are canonical front and back character reference sheets. Preserve that exact character, face, industrial-fantasy costume, brass disk backpack, three canisters, black hoses, cyan crystal handheld device, rendering style, transparency and two camera angles. Correct the WALK CYCLE CONTINUITY in Image 1 and keep exactly 16 sprites.
The current sheet fails because most poses repeat the same forward leg and the device switches hands. Replace ALL leg poses with one mechanically correct eight-frame WALK cycle repeated for front view and back view. This is walking, not running, with at least one planted foot every frame. Keep the device in exactly the same anatomical RIGHT hand for every one of the 16 sprites; the LEFT hand is always empty and swings.
Lay out uniform 4 columns × 4 rows, square sheet, exact equal square cells. Shrink every figure to only 70% of cell height with generous 14% empty margin above and 14% margin below. Keep every part strictly inside its own cell with clean transparent gutters; no figure touches the next row. Feet contact anchor approximately x=50%, y=86% of its cell. Same root position, same scale and same camera for every frame.
Top 8 cells are one front-three-quarter facing screen-right walk cycle, in reading order:
0 LEFT FOOT forward on ground, RIGHT FOOT extended back, BOTH legs visibly separated.
1 LEFT stance leg bends under weight, right heel rises at back.
2 LEFT stance leg supports the body, RIGHT KNEE passes forward in front of left calf, right boot clearly OFF ground.
3 LEFT supporting heel rises, RIGHT foot reaches forward almost touching, narrow high pose.
4 RIGHT FOOT forward on ground, LEFT FOOT extended back, BOTH legs visibly separated — explicitly OPPOSITE of cell 0. The forward leg must be the OTHER leg.
5 RIGHT stance leg bends under weight, left heel rises at back — opposite of cell 1.
6 RIGHT stance leg supports body, LEFT KNEE passes forward in front of right calf, left boot clearly OFF ground — opposite of cell 2.
7 RIGHT supporting heel rises, LEFT foot reaches forward almost touching — opposite of cell 3.
Bottom 8 cells are exactly these same temporal gait phases from a rear-three-quarter view facing screen-right, with correct left and right anatomy. Match phase 0 to 8, 1 to 9, etc. Do not rotate the character around during either cycle.
Emphasize clear CONTACT → DOWN → PASSING → UP → OPPOSITE CONTACT → DOWN → PASSING → UP. The biggest differences between frames must be alternating leg poses, not weapon drift or extra fingers. Shoulders rotate gently opposite hips, coat and hoses lag subtly. Device held low in right hand steadily without arm crossing body. Stable root, no sliding, no spell effects.
Transparent RGBA background. No text, numbering, gridlines, background, cast shadow, floor, props detached from the character, extra limbs, extra characters, missing feet, cropped device or copy-paste duplicate poses. No contact shadows. Exactly 16 complete sprites.
